_comment: Canned Azure detect output for the bernabeu-counter scorer frame (10.0s). Drives the Alt-C derive of api/examples/bernabeu-counter_cache.json: FakeAzureVision(objects=...) returns THESE for every sampled frame, so the sampling stride is what populates the detect keys. Deliberately NOT in det_id or confidence order so minting exercises the sort. `ball` is present to verify class filtering (dropped, like the hero fixture). The highest-confidence person (0.781) is the white #7 scorer whose box matches the manifest pin's nearest_box, so it mints to p0 and the pin renames it to p_vini. Consumed by test_new_clip_precompute_derives_cache_from_fixture.
